title: Why vibration draws patterns in sand
description: Vibration draws the pattern. The sand gathers near the lines that stay still: nodes. Different modes can make different patterns. Original illustrative model; synthetic narration; tones are not calibrated. #Chladni #Physics #Sound
firstComment: The lines are nodes of the plate. The tones here illustrate the idea; they are not calibrated to these patterns. Sources: Smithsonian, Exploratorium and UNSW Physics.
